description: Task: write a Python function solve(grid) that returns the number of separate land regions in a rectangular map. The argument grid is a list of 1 to 30 rows, each a list of 1 to 30 one-character strings, all rows of equal length; '1' marks land and '0' marks water. Two land cells belong to the same region when they are joined through a sequence of land cells, each sharing a side (up, down, left or right) with the next; touching only at a corner does not join them. A map with no land has 0 regions.

Use only the Python standard library. Return only one ```python code block containing the function solve and any helpers, with no example usage and no explanation.
